title: Affine section equivalence for the conormal wedge chart
statement: For a closed immersion i:Z→Y, an affine open U of Y, and n≥0, set V=i⁻¹U, N=i*(ker i), E=exteriorSheaf N n, M=conormalExteriorModule Gamma(Y,U) (ker i).ideal(U) n, and T to the associated-sheaf/restriction/pushforward/tensor-pullback functor of new-t2-self-tor-affine-section. There is a Gamma(Z,V)-linear equivalence E(V) ≃ T(M)(V) sending every wedge of the canonical pullback-unit ideal sections to selfTorAffineSection i U M (selfTorIdealWedge i U n b). These are exactly the objects of the parent chart theorem; no sheaf map is asserted.

source.place: Lemmas 26.7.1, 26.7.2(2), 26.7.3(1), and 26.7.4; conormal identification from Tag 01R3(2) and canonical unit from Tag 0096.

proof.text: Use affine_conormal_sections to identify N(V) with I/I², with its canonical pullback-unit formula. Descend A-linearity to B=A/I-linearity because A→B is onto. Exterior powers and their alternating maps commute with localization, so sheafification on V has sections the nth exterior B-module. On V the affine model T(M) is the sheaf associated to B tensor_A M, canonically M because I annihilates M. The tilde and tensor-pullback units give its constant sections. Compose the B-linear identifications; their pure-wedge formulas give the equation, including degree zero and empty charts.

theorem exists_selfTor_conormal_wedge_chart_section_equiv
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (n : ℕ) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf N n
    let M := conormalExteriorModule (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    ∃ e : ((E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))))) ≃ₗ[Z.presheaf.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))]
        ((T.obj M).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))),
      ∀ b : Fin n → i.ker.toModules.val.obj (op U.1),
        e (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection N n (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
          (fun j ↦ ((Classical.choose
            (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
              i.ker.toModules).val.app (op U.1) (b j))) =
          selfTorAffineSection i U M (selfTorIdealWedge i U n b)
